_comment: exfils-stage2 (docs/progress/exfils-stage2.md): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to the map descriptor; emits base.json 'exits'. The client authors the ExfiltrationPoint objects at runtime from ArenaMapRegistry.<Map>.Exits (ArenaMapPort.Shared/ArenaMapDescriptor.cs) — names, positions and box sizes there must equal this file (unit test). Positions are floor points at the ground-floor edges, NavMesh-sampled in-game; EntryPoints is always the map's infiltration name. Host test 1 (2026-09-20): floor ends at z ~49.6 (north) / ~-44 (south); spawn booths are NavMesh islands; gates sit 10 m from the nearest spawn so nobody spawns inside a trigger box. 2026-10-23 (equator-booth-spawns.md): the player spawns moved onto Arena's own markers inside the booths, so the gates now share the booths with them; the nearest spawn point is 2.6 m outside a box (Usec, North Gate) and no point lies inside one.
